question: Which hosts run PostgreSQL, and what decides it?
key: Magnetite only. No single site decides it: it follows from the modules magnetite takes. gitea (`modules/nixos/gitea.nix:56-60`), niks3 and nixbot (`database.createLocally`), gitea-mq and matrix (shared instance) come from magnetite's host module; omnigent comes from the omnigent clan service, which imports `nixos.omnigent` into every machine of its instance (`modules/clan/services/omnigent/flake-module.nix:20-23`) and whose server role on magnetite (`modules/clan/inventory/services/omnigent.nix:62`) sets `services.omnigent.enable`, which turns PostgreSQL on (`modules/nixos/omnigent.nix:61-70`)
trap: cinnabar's `matrix-server` is tuwunel, not a PostgreSQL host

question: What do I edit to give tara a home on pyrite?
key: Add `pyrite.users.tara` in `modules/lib/host-users.nix:152-170`. On NixOS this also needs `meta.sopsAgeKeyId` and a bridge key (`guides/home-manager-onboarding.md:179`)
pathToday: README, then host-users.nix, then the guide (3)
trap: `home-manager.users` must not be written in the host body

question: What changes if I edit `modules/system/zram-swap.nix`?
key: It defines `nixos.base-zram-swap` (`:3`), which is listed at `nixos/base.nix:39` and so reaches all six NixOS hosts; magnetite overrides it (`memoryPercent` 150)
trap: README:22 calls `system/` "cross-platform", but this file is NixOS-only

question: In what order do darwin postActivation steps run?
key: `activationOrder` at `modules/system/deploy-record.nix:197-212`: resolver 500, default 1000, sops 1500, casks 1502, dnscrypt 1503, trust 1504, record 1900

question: Where does nixbot's GitHub App key come from, and who can read it?
key: Declared at `modules/nixos/nixbot.nix:116-125` (owner `nixbot`; the generator script exits 1, so it is set by hand with `clan vars set`). Recipients: `vars/per-machine/magnetite/nixbot-github-app-secret-key/key.pem/{machines/magnetite,users/cameron}`
trap: `system/secrets.nix` translates the declaration into clan vars

question: Which hosts can decrypt the ntfy-alerter token?
key: `share = true` at `modules/nixos/ntfy-alerter.nix:23-25`; recipients are the 9 hosts plus cameron under `vars/shared/ntfy-alerter/token/`; judged by `lib/shared-vars-recipients.nix:1-15`

question: A darwin deploy fails with "0 successful groups required". Why?
key: The host deploys a shared secret it is not a recipient of (`lib/shared-vars-recipients.nix:1-15`)

question: Which evaluator does pyrite get?
key: memory 16 (`lib/hosts.nix:313`) matches the NixOS 15 GiB rule (`lib/nix-eval-jobs-host.nix:58-62`): iets, 1 worker × 2048 MiB

question: Which host builds `checks.aarch64-darwin` for nixbot?
key: Stibnite only. Magnetite excludes pyrite, rosegold and argentum (`clan/inventory/services/nix-builders.nix:73-80,112-119`)

question: Is galena provisioned?
key: No: `enabled = false` at `modules/lib/cloud-machines.nix:55`

question: Who may ask the fleet deployer to deploy argentum?
key: Cameron. The policy also reaches christophersmith, argentum's primary user (`host-users.nix:203-207`), but he holds no request credential (`lib/fleet-deployer.nix:11-15,36-49`)

question: Which worker accounts run on pyrite?
key: omnigent-cameron and omnigent-janettesmith (`lib/fleet-workers.nix:58-80`)

question: What decides a host's system and class?
key: `system` in `lib/hosts.nix:232-365`; `clan/machines.nix:6-9` derives `hostPlatform` from it, and `class` is derived in `hosts.nix:185-191`

question: Where is a host's machine module?
key: `modules/machines/<class>/<name>/default.nix`
trap: The agent context's `10-repository-overview.instructions.md` says `machines/`, which holds only `facter.json`; the onboarding guide (`host-onboarding.md:85`) says `<hostname>.nix`

question: Where is the ntfy server defined?
key: `modules/machines/nixos/cinnabar/ntfy.nix:3`, as `nixos.ntfy-server`, imported at `cinnabar/default.nix:47`

question: Who bumps flake inputs, and when?
key: The scheduled nixbot effect `flake-update`, Tuesday and Friday per its comments, as App `vanixiets-flake-updater` (`modules/effects/vanixiets/effects.nix:44-56,156-169`)

question: What must a new check declare before it can merge?
key: A `testSizes.checks` entry beside its definition (for example `checks/deploy-record-order.nix:66`); the option is in `checks/test-sizes.nix`

question: In what order are nixpkgs overlays applied?
key: Internal overlays first, then `pkgs/by-name` (`nixpkgs/compose.nix:38-43`). Within the internal list, no file declares an order; it is module merge order (`overlays-option.nix:13`)
trap: The comment at compose.nix:38 says "order matters!"

question: What are stibnite's primary user and uid?
key: crs58, primary and admin, uid 501 (`lib/host-users.nix:174-178`)

question: What is a host's deploy address?
key: `<deployUser>@<name>.zt` (`lib/hosts.nix:203`). The overlay address is a separate field (`:195`)
